newsitem.title: JAPAN: Victor to launch DVD player in Japan on April 21.
newsitem.headline: Victor to launch DVD player in Japan on April 21.

text.p: Victor Co said on Wednesday that it would launch its first digital video disc (DVD) player in Japan on April 21.
The player, XV-1000, will be priced at 93,000 yen, the company said in a statement.
The company plans to start marketing DVD software at the same time as the player's launch.
"We waited until software titles were ready to hit the market before launching our first DVD player," a company spokesman said.
Victor will initially offer three movie titles and a similar number of music titles and expects to raise the number of titles to 20 by the end of the year, the statement said.
Victor also plans to launch its DVD player in the United States in June, it said.
The company also said it would begin mass production of DVDs at its plant in Kanagawa prefecture.
DVD is a new recording system which has a large storage capacity and is expected to eventually replace videocassette recorders, compact disc (CD) players and CD-ROMs.
Matsushita Electric Industrial Co Ltd started selling DVD players in Japan in November.
